source.publication: 2025 Expanded Instructions (IA 1040) and the 2025 IA 1040 Iowa Individual Income Tax Return
source.section: IA 1040 form PDF p.1 Step 3 lines a, b, d; form PDF p.2 lines 1c, 2-5, 7, 8, 11, 12; Instructions PDF p.8 Step 3; PDF p.9-10 lines 2-4; PDF p.12 line 5 ('Iowa now has a flat tax rate of 3.8%'); PDF p.18 line 12; Schedule 1 line 1 column B, PDF p.64-65

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 60,000.00 + U.S. Treasury interest 16,000.00 = 76,000.00. Federal taxable income = 76,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 60,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IA 1040 filing status 1 (single). Step 3 line a personal credits 1 x 40.00 = 40.00; line b 0 x 20.00 = 0.00 (65 or older on or before January 1, 2026; nobody blind); line c no dependents; line d and line 8 = 40.00. Line 1c federal AGI 76,000.00; line 2 federal taxable income 60,250.00. Schedule 1 line 1 column B (federal securities): the booklet subtracts the Treasury interest 16,000.00, but the projection cannot tell it from other interest, so 0.00 here. Schedule 1 line 21 net modifications = 0.00; line 3 = 0.00. Line 4 Iowa taxable income = 60,250.00 + (0.00) = 60,250.00. Line 5 tax = 3.8% x 60,250.00 = 2,289.50; line 7 = 2,289.50. Line 11 total credits 40.00; line 12 balance = 2,289.50 - 40.00 = 2,249.50. State income tax 2,249.50 (no line 13-17 credits; line 19 school district or EMS surtax is local, not computed). The form allows whole-dollar rounding; expected keeps the cents. Low-income exemption test (PDF p.10-11): line 4 60,250.00 + federal deduction 15,750.00 = 76,000.00, against 9,000.00: not exempt. Single filers' tax reduction (PDF p.18): its worksheet 41-146 is not in the sources, so it is not applied. The form's figure is 1,641.50: line 1 column B subtracts the 16,000.00, line 4 is 44,250.00 and the tax 1,681.50. The projection's 2,249.50 is 608.00 too much, the approximation's own example.
accepted_approximations: Interest on U.S. Treasury obligations is taxed (the projection cannot tell it from other interest).
Interest from federal securities and dividends attributable to them are subtracted; the projection cannot tell them from other interest and dividends.
School district and county EMS surtaxes (a percentage of the tax, form line 19) are local and out of scope (issue #1).
